provider.name: GHSL (EU JRC)
provider.abstract: EU Joint Research Centre Global Human Settlement Layer — population grids, built-up area, settlement classification, and urbanization trends. Free WMS, no key required.
provider.note: The GHSL GeoServer WMS was withdrawn. The programme now distributes GHS-POP/BUILT/SMOD as downloadable rasters only; no tile service is published.

layers.title: Population Grid 2020 (100m)
layers.abstract: Estimated population per 100m grid cell for 2020. Global Human Settlement Population Grid R2023A. RETIRED: the JRC GHSL GeoServer was withdrawn; ghsl.jrc.ec.europa.eu now redirects to human-settlement.emergency.copernicus.eu, which publishes no WMS.
